description: Auth token on the live WebSocket URL (?token=...): `<unix expiry>.<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the expiry digits, keyed with the shared API key>`. Signed by lib/ml-backend.ts (signLiveToken), checked by ml-backend/app/api/auth.py (valid_live_token); tests on both sides assert they agree with this file. The key below is a test value, not a secret.
